images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: one standalone rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, 089 T-LOW-014 step 01, no collage. Use all three supplied reference images only as identity, outfit, gray-blue studio background and soft photographic lighting references; do not copy their arm pose. Preserve exactly this same adult East Asian woman, black ponytail, white plain short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers. Full body standing on matte gray non-slip floor, including entire head, both hands and both feet. Plain gray athletic shoes. Nearly side view with a small frontal angle so both identical compact black hex dumbbells and their grips remain visible. She stands upright facing right, feet comfortably hip-width apart at fixed positions, knees slightly soft, neutral spine and neck. Each hand securely grasps one identical dumbbell; straight relaxed arms hang down, weights held closely just in front of her thighs, neutral wrists, palms toward body. Dumbbells already acquired, standing start position of a dumbbell Romanian deadlift, no floor pickup. Minimal gray-blue seamless studio backdrop, natural soft shadow, realistic anatomy and materials, calm instructional expression, consistent scale, substantial clear margin around full body. Exactly one woman, exactly two hands holding exactly two dumbbells. No words, numerals, arrows, badges, logos, watermarks or additional objects. Do not crop feet or weights.

review.method: 逐张使用view_image目视核对；根代理复审090组
review.pose: 站姿起点，双哑铃近腿前，双足站稳，膝轻屈，手腕握持自然。
review.identity_background: 同一女性外观、白短袖/深灰裤/黑马尾、灰蓝棚拍背景与柔光，写实质感保持。
review.anatomy_framing: 人体比例、连续关节和握持自然，头/双手/双足/完整器械入镜，无遮挡关键接触；无文字编号箭头水印。
review.equipment: 两只同款黑色六角哑铃，固定足位
review.limitations: 生成画面有少量体位透视差异；同一身份、器材及机位感保持。
review.cannot_verify: 静态生成图不能证明肌肉发力、真实负荷或临床有效性。

images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate one standalone rehabilitation demonstration photograph for 089 T-LOW-014 step 02. Image 1 is the exact preceding standing start frame: preserve its same woman's identity, white short-sleeved T-shirt, charcoal trousers, black ponytail, gray athletic shoes, two black hex dumbbells, studio gray-blue floor/backdrop, lighting, camera, focal length and body scale. Images 2–4 are original appearance references. Change only the exercise pose to the controlled lower position of a dumbbell Romanian deadlift. Her feet stay exactly at the same floor locations facing right; knees remain only gently bent, not a squat. Push hips backward and hinge at the hip joints; neutral straight spine from pelvis through torso, chest inclines about 45 degrees, head and neck follow spine naturally with gaze diagonally toward floor. Both arms hang straight vertically down from the shoulders, each hand securely holds the same compact dumbbell with neutral wrist. Dumbbells travel CLOSE beside the front of the legs to just below knee or upper shin level, a comfortable endpoint far above floor; do not reach weights forward. Full body, whole head, both feet, both hands and both dumbbells complete and clearly visible. Same nearly-side slightly frontal viewpoint for inspecting hip hinge and both weights. Maintain neutral controlled posture and realistic anatomy. Exactly one pose, no collage. No text, numerals, arrows, logos, watermark. Do not lift from floor, deeply squat, round back, flex elbows or add equipment.

images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create preparation step 01 from this photograph by placing this SAME barbell back UP onto the existing two fixed black stand cradles. KEEP BOTH stands totally untouched, original empty black cradles at their current permanent top height (around image y640), original positions, footprints, contour and lengths; do not move, shorten or change stands. Raise ONLY the barbell and both hands approximately 10 cm so shaft is actually resting supported in BOTH CURRENT cradles, not held below them. Woman stays upright same planted stance and relaxed shoulders; her two elbows must now BEND naturally approximately 20 degrees to keep both hands securely overhand gripping the RACKED bar at lower-waist height. This is preparation BEFORE taking bar out. Both real cradle-to-shaft support contacts visible and both hands still gripping. Same woman/face/hair/white shirt/charcoal trousers/gray shoes, bar shaft, ONE black disc and outside collar per end, camera, background, floor, lighting, scale and framing; all head/hands/feet/bar ends and stand bases complete. Do not change post heights or add any supports; the bar moves UP to the existing top cradles. Single photorealistic image, no words, arrows, numbers, logos, watermark, collage.

images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY the woman's forearms and the hand-held bar from racked preparation to unracked standing hold. The shaft must move DOWN 8 centimeters, approximately from current image y700 to image y760, now close in front of her thighs. Both elbows extend naturally, wrists neutral, both hands retain overhand shoulder-width grip, relaxed shoulders, knees soft, woman upright stable, both feet planted. Both smooth black fixed support stands MUST be absolutely frozen unchanged at same height, footprint and pixel locations: LEFT cradle remains x290 y700 and RIGHT cradle x870 y700, LEFT base at bottom left, RIGHT base at lower right. Do not raise/lower/move stands or change their contours; do not move camera/background/body. The same bar is held solely by both hands BELOW and slightly in front of the two now EMPTY original cradles. There is a clear visible gap of 8cm between the shaft and the cradle tops; if overlap in perspective, shaft is clearly in foreground. Same complete silver bar with SAME one black disc and OUTSIDE black collar per end. Preserve woman's face, black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, gray running shoes, full anatomy, soft gray-blue studio frame, light and shadows. Feet and full bar ends visible. One photo only, no text/arrows/numbers/logo/watermark/collage. No floor pull, overhead action, squat or additional supports.

images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Change ONLY this woman's exercise pose from upright step 02 to controlled lower position step 03 of the same barbell Romanian deadlift. Freeze the ENTIRE same studio scene: same two smooth black fixed stands with ONE empty top cradle each at exact original height and footprint, bases, gray-blue background/floor boundary, fixed camera angle/framing and soft light. Do not alter post lengths, cradle contours or stand position. Keep same woman's identity, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, gray shoes and same feet planted in original locations. Her hips and buttocks move BACK, torso hinges forward at HIP joints about 40–45 degrees, neutral straight spine, head aligned with spine naturally looking diagonally downward. Knees remain only mildly bent, no deep squat. BOTH arms hang vertically DOWN from shoulders, BOTH hands keep secure double-overhand shoulder-width grasp and neutral wrists. Same silver shaft with same ONE black disc and outside black collar per end travels CLOSE along the fronts of legs down to chosen endpoint near kneecaps / upper shins, still far above floor; do not reach forward. Both empty original cradles stay visible well ABOVE the lowered bar and untouched. Complete head, hands, feet, full bar including both end plate/collar assemblies and stand bases visible. Realistic continuous joint connections and grip, controlled neutral body position, one single photorealistic pose only. No text, numerals, arrows, logos/watermark/collage, floor pickup, curls, rounded lumbar back or new equipment.

images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY this woman's head direction and gaze slightly: lower her chin to look down and confirm the silver barbell has just returned safely to BOTH support cradles at the end of her exercise. Both hands still securely overhand grasp the racked shaft; fingers closed, wrists natural, elbows softly bent. Freeze absolutely ALL other elements unchanged from this image: bar resting in exact SAME black cradle contact positions, both smooth black stand posts/base footprint/height/shape, same bar shaft and ONE black disc with outside black collar per end, complete woman's upright body/clothes/shoes/stance/identity, camera frame/body scale/gray-blue background and matte floor/light/shadow. Only change the face/head's glance downward a small natural amount, no body reposition or equipment change. This is step04 bar safely returned before releasing hands, single standalone realistic photo. No text/numbers/arrows/logo/watermark/collage. Keep head, both feet/hands, complete bar and stand bases uncropped.
